data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 473.6m (2019: GBP 302.5m) is a deterioration of GBP 7.9m (2019: deterioration of GBP 8.4m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Property, Third party liability and Accident and Health with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.

prior_year_events.event_name: Reinsurance to Close (RITC) of Syndicates 5820 and 1206 into Syndicate 1861 2018 year of account
prior_year_events.impact_description: Assumed reserves from Syndicates 5820 and 1206 were included in the opening position for 2020, producing a material increase in gross claims outstanding at the opening balance and causing significant apparent adverse development in the gross claims development table.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net deterioration in prior year reserves (a reported net GBP 7.9m deterioration) driven principally by unfavourable development in Property, Third party liability (Casualty) and Accident & Health. The 2020 results were materially impacted by the Covid-19 pandemic (GBP 128m net) and elevated catastrophe frequency in the US (notably Hurricane Laura, net GBP 21.5m), and movements in gross reserves are distorted by the inclusion of reinsurance-to-close (RITC) business assumed from other syndicates at the opening of 2020. As a result a reliable aggregate gross prior-year movement (insurance liabilities) is not presented in the notes without adjustment for the RITC.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 473.6m (2019: GBP 302.5m) is a deterioration of GBP 7.9m (2019: deterioration of GBP 8.4m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Property, Third party liability and Accident and Health with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.
Claims in respect of the Covid-19 pandemic total GBP 128m net of reinsurance recoveries, adding 27% to the net loss ratio.

Catastrophe experience in the year was heavier than expectation and whilst no single loss would be considered market changing on its own, there was a marked increase in the frequency of events contributing 10.7% to the net claims ratio.
Syndicate's biggest exposure to these was through hurricane Laura (net incurred claims of GBP 21.5m).
data.data_quality_notes: A reliable aggregate GROSS prior year development figure could not be determined from the notes: the only explicit prior-year movement statement is a NET deterioration (GBP 7.9m) and the gross claims development table is materially distorted by a reinsurance-to-close (RITC) transaction (assumption of Syndicates 5820 and 1206) recorded at the opening position. Consequently the gross prior-year movement has been left null and the RITC distortion noted as a caveat.
